name: hcapp_addEditEvent
description: Creates or updates an HC.Event for a kennel. Mode is whether @eventId already exists in HC.Event for @kennelId: found → partial UPDATE; not found or NULL → INSERT. @kennelId may be omitted when @eventId is given (default NULL since 2026-09-30, derived from the event; the run-number edit sends only @eventId); missing on both counts → 1220. Sentinels: NULL = keep existing; -1 = keep (normalised to NULL) for numeric fields; -2 = explicitly clear for lat/lon/prices; '<remove>' clears strings ('<none>' for extrasDescription, 0 for absoluteEventNumber); @deleteEventImage = 1 clears the cover photo. On INSERT a placeholder name is generated if @eventName is empty, the kennel's DefaultRunStartTime is applied to a midnight start, and kennel default prices fill missing prices. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 20, standard token). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'createEditRuns' for @kennelId, with the designated hare of an EXISTING event allowed (HasherEventMap.IsHare) → else 1321 (errorType 13). An event that exists but belongs to another kennel → 1320. Editing a run the AI imported from the kennel's runs page adopts it (HC6.nonApi_adoptImportedRun) so the import stops updating it, and forces the UseFb* mirror flags off. After the write: HC.nonApi_updateRunNumbers, HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForEventUsers, COMMIT, the success envelope, an adHocData row { adHocDataId = 1, eventId } and then HC6.hcapp_syncUserData's rowsets (events / HasherEventMap / HasherKennelMap for the given watermarks, hashers 'ignore'). The same SP serves the portal's run editor (James, 2026-10-09: run editing is ONE feature on both sides).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic auth token. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: narrowEventsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark for events passed through to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. Pass 'ignore' to skip event sync; NULL is defaulted to 'ignore' internally. NO SQL DEFAULT — a client that omits it is refused before the procedure runs (see codeSmells).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to update. NULL or null-UUID (00000000-...) triggers INSERT mode. Null-UUID is normalised to NULL internally. On UPDATE, the event must belong to @kennelId — cross-kennel writes are rejected with error 1320.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The event's kennel. Default NULL (since 2026-09-30): when NULL or the zero UUID and @eventId names an existing event, taken from HC.Event.KennelId. Still missing after that → error 1220. Scopes the write and the permission check; an @eventId that belongs to a different kennel → 1320.

parameters.name: startDatetime
parameters.description: Event start date/time. Required for INSERT mode. Sentinel: values <= 1901-01-01 are normalised to NULL. On INSERT with a midnight time component, the kennel's DefaultRunStartTime is applied.

parameters.name: endDatetime
parameters.description: Event end date/time. Optional. Sentinel: values <= 1901-01-01 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: isCountedRun
parameters.description: Whether this event counts toward run totals. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). Defaults to 0 on INSERT.

parameters.name: isVisible
parameters.description: Whether the event is publicly visible. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). Defaults to 1 on INSERT.

parameters.name: usersCanEditRunAttendence
parameters.description: Whether users can edit their own run attendance. Sentinel: -1 = explicitly set column to NULL (not 'keep'); NULL = keep existing. This is the inverse of all other -1 sentinels in this SP — -1 here means 'clear' not 'keep'.

parameters.name: isPromotedEvent
parameters.description: Whether the event is promoted. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). Defaults to 0 on INSERT.

parameters.name: eventGeographicScope
parameters.description: Geographic scope of the event (e.g. 1=normal run, 4=Nash Hash). Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). Defaults to 0 on INSERT.

parameters.name: ThemeRunType
parameters.description: Theme run type code. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). Defaults to 0 on INSERT.
parameters.typeMismatch: SMALLINT parameter — Event.ThemeRunType is INT. Widening is safe at runtime but the types are inconsistent.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: Event name. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). On INSERT with empty/NULL name, a placeholder is generated using the kennel short name. Unicode line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029) are stripped.

parameters.name: eventDescription
parameters.description: Event description. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). '<remove>' clears to NULL. Unicode line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029) are stripped.

parameters.name: locationCity
parameters.description: City component of the event location. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL.

parameters.name: locationStreet
parameters.description: Street component of the event location. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL.

parameters.name: locationPostCode
parameters.description: Post/zip code. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL.

parameters.name: locationCountry
parameters.description: Country component of the event location. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL.

parameters.name: locationRegion
parameters.description: Region component of the event location. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL.

parameters.name: locationSubRegion
parameters.description: Sub-region component of the event location. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL.

parameters.name: locationOneLineDesc
parameters.description: One-line location description fallback. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears to NULL. Unicode line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029) are stripped.

parameters.name: eventFacebookId
parameters.description: Facebook event ID. Sentinel: LEN < 5 normalised to NULL. If value contains the substring 'break', silently cleared to empty string.

parameters.name: coverPhotoUrl
parameters.description: URL of the event cover photo (Event.EventImage). Sentinel: LEN < 5 normalised to NULL (keep existing). To clear, send @deleteEventImage = 1 rather than a short string.

parameters.name: deleteEventImage
parameters.description: 1 = clear Event.EventImage to NULL on UPDATE (wins over @coverPhotoUrl). Default 0. Ignored on INSERT.

parameters.name: coverPhotoOffsetX
parameters.description: Horizontal offset for cover photo cropping. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Defaults to 0 on INSERT.
parameters.typeMismatch: INT parameter — Event.EventImageOffsetX is SMALLINT. Narrowing cast is safe within normal offset value ranges but the types are inconsistent.

parameters.name: coverPhotoOffsetY
parameters.description: Vertical offset for cover photo cropping. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Defaults to 0 on INSERT.
parameters.typeMismatch: INT parameter — Event.EventImageOffsetY is SMALLINT. Narrowing cast is safe within normal offset value ranges but the types are inconsistent.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Event latitude. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). -2 = explicitly clear to NULL. EventGeolocation is recomputed from the resolved lat/lon.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Event longitude. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). -2 = explicitly clear to NULL. EventGeolocation is recomputed from the resolved lat/lon.

parameters.name: fbLatitude
parameters.description: Facebook-sourced latitude fallback. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: fbLongitude
parameters.description: Facebook-sourced longitude fallback. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: eventPriceForMembers
parameters.description: Member ticket price. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). -2 = explicitly clear to NULL. On INSERT, falls back to HC.Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForMembers.

parameters.name: eventPriceForNonMembers
parameters.description: Non-member ticket price. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). -2 = explicitly clear to NULL. On INSERT, falls back to HC.Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForNonMembers.

parameters.name: eventPriceForExtras
parameters.description: Extras price. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). -2 = explicitly clear to NULL.

parameters.name: extrasDescription
parameters.description: Description of extras. Sentinel: LEN < 1 normalised to NULL. '<none>' clears to NULL. Note: uses '<none>' not '<remove>' — inconsistent with all other string clear sentinels in this SP.

parameters.name: absoluteEventNumber
parameters.description: Override run number. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). 0 = explicitly clear to NULL. Note: uses 0 to clear rather than -2 — inconsistent with lat/lon and price clear sentinels.

parameters.name: eventCurrencyType
parameters.description: ISO currency code. Sentinel: LEN < 4 normalised to NULL (keep existing).

parameters.name: useFbLatLon
parameters.description: Whether to use Facebook lat/lon for EventGeolocation. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing).

parameters.name: useFbRunDetails
parameters.description: Whether to use Facebook run details for display. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing).

parameters.name: useFbLocation
parameters.description: Whether to use Facebook location for display. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing).

parameters.name: useFbImage
parameters.description: Whether to use Facebook image for display. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing).

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: Soft-delete flag. NULL (default) = keep existing; 1 = mark the event deleted via the standard UPDATE COALESCE path; 0 on INSERT when NULL. SMALLINT by house rule; Event.deleted is the pre-existing BIT column and converts implicitly. The HC5 -1 'keep' sentinel is gone — pass NULL.
parameters.typeMismatch: SMALLINT parameter — Event.deleted is BIT (the one sanctioned BIT column; implicit conversion).

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark for HasherEventMap, passed through to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. NULL is defaulted to 'ignore' internally.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark for HasherKennelMap, passed through to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. NULL is defaulted to 'ignore' internally.

parameters.name: hares
parameters.description: Comma-separated hare names (not IDs). Sentinel: LEN < 4 normalised to NULL (keep existing). '<remove>' clears to NULL. Unicode line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029) are stripped. The HC5 INSERT bug (using @locationOneLineDesc instead of @hares) is fixed in HC6.

parameters.name: packOffMinutes
parameters.description: Pack-off (E3.F1.S6): minutes after the gather (the start time) that the pack leaves. NULL / -1 = keep, -2 = clear (the run then uses the kennel's default), 0..600 = this run's own. Outside 0..600 is refused. Refusal: errorCode 1227 / errorType 12.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always the first rowset. success = 1 with NULL errorCode/errorType on success; success = 0 with the code on any failure: ValidateAppAuth 1120 invalid token (errorType 1) / 1320 device not registered (3) / 1220 signed out (7); 1220 missing kennelId (12); 1321 not authorised (13); 1320 event belongs to another kennel (13); 1920 unhandled DB error (19). Note 1220 and 1320 are each used for two different conditions (auth vs validation).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success; otherwise see description.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success; 1/3/7 auth, 12 validation, 13 not authorised / not found, 19 unhandled.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: 'Missing parameter', 'Not authorised', 'Event not found', 'Unexpected error' or the ValidateAppAuth title.

rowsets.name: AdHocData
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success only: identifies the saved event (adHocDataId pattern, /hc6-adhoc-data) so the client can open it — essential after an INSERT, where the id was generated server-side.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: LOWER(CAST(@eventId AS NVARCHAR(40))) — the created or updated HC.Event.id.

rowsets.name: SyncUserDataRowsets
rowsets.description: On success only, after AdHocData: the rowsets of HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (see its contract) called with @hashersUpdatedAfter = 'ignore', the three caller watermarks (NULL → 'ignore'), @usePaging = 0, @procName = this SP's name and @param NULL — so the token the client generated for hcapp_addEditEvent validates inside the sync SP too.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Event — when @eventId exists for @kennelId (COALESCE partial update; EventSource = 'HC app'; updatedAt = GETDATE(), so the row re-syncs).
INSERT HC.Event — when @eventId is NULL or not found; only when a name (or placeholder) is non-empty AND @startDatetime is non-NULL. InboundIntegrationId 0, countryId from the kennel.

EXEC HC6.nonApi_adoptImportedRun @eventId — on UPDATE; when it reports adopted = 1 a second UPDATE forces UseFbRunDetails/UseFbLocation/UseFbLatLon/UseFbImage = 0 and recomputes EventGeolocation from Latitude/Longitude.
EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunNumbers @eventId — inside the transaction after the write.
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForEventUsers @eventId — inside the transaction; a renumber cascade that shifts LATER events leaves their attendees briefly stale until the nightly recompute.
EXEC HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'createEditRuns' (@isHareOfEvent from HasherEventMap.IsHare) — pre-flight, outside the transaction.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on 1220, 1321, 1320 (pre-flight) and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData — after COMMIT and outside TRY/CATCH; its rowsets stream to the caller.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: Inconsistent clear sentinels across parameter groups
codeSmells.detail: @extrasDescription uses '<none>' to clear, while all other string fields use '<remove>'. @absoluteEventNumber uses 0 to clear, while numeric/decimal fields use -2. Three different clear sentinel patterns in one SP increases caller complexity and error risk.

For every other SMALLINT parameter, -1 is normalised to NULL meaning 'keep existing'. For @usersCanEditRunAttendence, -1 is NOT normalised — it is left as -1 and used inline as CASE WHEN @usersCanEditRunAttendence = -1 THEN NULL, meaning 'set column to NULL'. This is the opposite semantic to every other -1 sentinel in the SP and is not documented in parameter comments.

codeSmells.issue: ThemeRunType parameter type is SMALLINT but column is INT
codeSmells.detail: @ThemeRunType is declared SMALLINT in the SP signature but Event.ThemeRunType is INT. No explicit CAST is present; implicit widening occurs. The mismatch is harmless at current value ranges but should be aligned.

codeSmells.issue: coverPhotoOffsetX/Y parameter types are INT but columns are SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: @coverPhotoOffsetX and @coverPhotoOffsetY are declared INT in the SP signature but Event.EventImageOffsetX and EventImageOffsetY are SMALLINT. No explicit CAST. Implicit narrowing — could truncate values outside the SMALLINT range.

codeSmells.issue: INSERT guard redundantly re-checks @kennelId IS NOT NULL
codeSmells.detail: The INSERT guard at line 365 includes AND @kennelId IS NOT NULL. By this point @kennelId has already been validated (lines 151-167) and would have returned early. Harmless noise.

codeSmells.issue: Sync delegation runs outside TRY/CATCH after the envelope has been sent
codeSmells.detail: Lines 496-509: EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData runs after COMMIT and outside the TRY. The write is committed and { success = 1 } plus the adHocData row have already gone out, so a failure inside the sync SP reaches the client as a raw error after a success envelope; the client sees the save as failed although it is on the server.

codeSmells.issue: errorCode values collide with ValidateAppAuth codes
codeSmells.detail: 1220 (missing kennelId, line 157) equals ValidateAppAuth's signed-out code 1200 + 20, and 1320 (cross-kennel event, line 264) equals its device-not-registered code 1300 + 20; only errorType distinguishes them (12/13 vs 7/3).

breakingChanges: @eventName widened from NVARCHAR(120) to NVARCHAR(250) to match Event.EventName column.
@locationPostCode widened from NVARCHAR(50) to NVARCHAR(250) to match Event.LocationPostCode column.
@eventPriceForMembers, @eventPriceForNonMembers, @eventPriceForExtras changed from FLOAT to DECIMAL(10,4) to match Event column types.
@deleted stays SMALLINT (maps to the BIT column by implicit conversion). The SMALLINT -1 sentinel (keep existing) is removed; pass NULL to keep the existing value.
@narrowEventsUpdatedAfter changed from DATETIMEOFFSET(7) to NVARCHAR(50) to match the hcapp_syncUserData watermark pattern.
@kennelId: NULL or null-UUID with no resolvable event returns error 1220 instead of silently falling through. Since 2026-09-30 it has a NULL default and is derived from @eventId when omitted.
HC5 INSERT bug fixed: Event.Hares now receives @hares (HC5 incorrectly used @locationOneLineDesc).
HC5 deletion stub removed: @deleted=1 now executes a real soft-delete via the UPDATE path.
HC.nonApi_updateRunNumbers moved inside the transaction (HC5 called it outside any transaction).
TRY/CATCH and transaction added (HC5 had neither).
Success envelope rowset added as rowset 0 (HC5 had no envelope — results came from syncUserData only).
Cross-kennel guard added: @eventId belonging to a different kennel now returns error 1320 instead of silently creating a duplicate INSERT (HC5 bug).
DATALENGTH replaced with LEN for all string length guards.
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncUserData to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.
2026-09-30: @kennelId gained a NULL default (derived from @eventId) — additive.
@deleteEventImage SMALLINT = 0 added (clears the cover photo) — additive.
adHocData rowset { adHocDataId, eventId } now precedes the syncUserData rowsets on success — a client that indexed the sync rowsets from 1 must index from 2.
